inputs.text: Harry Wait was just convicted by a Wisconsin jury of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent. This leader of a group that spreads false election claims has engaged in a direct assault on the democratic processes that marginalized communities depend on to push back against systemic inequality. By sowing doubt, these actions are meant to block the institutional reforms we need, ensuring that power remains with the privileged and that vulnerable groups face even greater challenges in having their voices heard and being protected from further disenfranchisement.
